item.title: Winning BrainHack ATL 2019
item.description: BrainHack ATL A few weeks ago, my advisor suggested that some labmates and I enter in a hackathon downtown called “BrainHack”. As I’m considering getting more into machine learning with applications to medicine, a hackathon which professes its purpose is: Bringing together students, researchers, non-academic industry professionals, engineers, data scientists, and neuroscientists from a variety of fields and expertise to explore the multiple applications of neuroimaging tools from a cross-disciplinary perspective.
